content.short: Thai ticketing platform for concerts, festivals and fan events, with a World App mini app.
content.description: Eventpop is one of Thailand's main ticketing sites, selling entry to concerts, fan meetings, festivals and seminars, and giving organisers tools to sell tickets and manage attendees. Recent listings range from shows at IMPACT Arena to BNK48 events and gallery exhibitions. Verified humans can also buy tickets without leaving World App.
content.meta: Buy tickets for Thai concerts, festivals and fan events on Eventpop, available on the web and as a World App mini app.
